authoring: Physics and world components with retained runtime bindings

behaviors.description: Select Player and edit World Studio → Character floor snap and safe margin.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Finite edits commit to Undo; invalid values restore the previous value.

behaviors.description: Play; use A/D and Space. Pause and single-step while falling or landing.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The character falls, jumps and lands once per fixed tick; the Platform is one-way and Moving Platform carries a supported character.

behaviors.description: Change Platform friction, layer/mask and one-way flag, then Undo/Redo.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The next native synchronization applies the authored shape/material/filter values.

behaviors.description: Save/reopen and export the exact project.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The reopened and exported player use the same component and script data. Keep the unbounded moving platform demonstration under20seconds or add a reversing controller.

behaviors.description: Read the visible X/Y meter values while playing in editor and export.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The readout follows the subject through the ordinary Rhai transform/UI APIs at10Hz; it can be compared with the Inspector while paused.
